title: Woodard Marine Guided Fishing Charters
specs: Captain Luke is a fully licensed angling expert and Vermont native
Boats equipped for water sports: wakeboarding, waterskiing, tubing
Premium pontoons have third toon for stability and Bluetooth stereo
Fishing license required for fishing charters
Passenger minimum age 4 years old for fishing charters
Drivers over 24 years old must have boating license for boat rentals
Drivers over 24 years old must have boating license for pontoon rentals
Fishing charters accommodate up to 3 people (1-2 included, $50 per extra person)
Deluxe runabout boats hold up to 8 passengers
gap: Duration options for boat rentals not fully detailed
blurb: Guests can book guided fishing charters with Captain Luke on Lake Bomoseen, targeting species like Bass, Northern Pike, and Brown Trout. They also offer various boat rentals including deluxe runabout boats and premium pontoon boats for water sports and cruising. Transient boat slip rentals are available for docking boats up to 24 feet.
extraNote: Cancellations 3 to 6 days prior: refund minus $100 fee or rebook same season/year without fee · Cancellations within 2 days: forfeit deposit, or rebook for $75 fee same season/year · Full dock at 615 Creek Road, Castleton, VT
